items.heading: Baleadas
details: Key ingredients: flour tortilla, refried beans, cheese, cream
Cook a thick flour tortilla on a hot griddle until soft and lightly spotted.
Spread a generous layer of refried beans over half.
Add crumbled cheese and a drizzle of cream.
Fold the tortilla over the filling and serve warm.

items.heading: Sopa de Caracol
details: Key ingredients: conch, coconut milk, plantain, yuca, vegetables
Simmer conch meat until tender.
Add coconut milk, plantain, yuca and vegetables.
Cook until everything is soft and the broth is rich and creamy.
Serve hot as a filling coastal soup.
